'''ThunderForce''' was a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] unit that was active during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was made up of highly trained [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] and specialized in ground combat and small unit tactics. They were often employed by corporate or local governments and rarely worked for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].<ref name="H&S" />

It was divided into two companies, [[Dazzle Company]] and [[Flash Company]]. Each company was divided into eight [[Platoon/Legends|platoons]]. The force was spread over three bases and two training facilities among two [[Star system/Legends|systems]].<ref name="H&S" />
